## Description
Brief summary of the proposed changes.

## Motivation & Context
Why is this change required? What issue does it solve?

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Optimization / Refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles without warnings (`cargo check`)
- [ ] All unit and doc tests pass (`cargo test`)
- [ ] Lints pass without errors (`cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Formatting is compliant (`cargo fmt --check`)
